description: Profile a Polymarket trader: realized P&L (24h / 7d / 30d / all-time), hit-rate on resolved markets, total volume, top categories traded, and recent positions. Use when the user gives a Polymarket wallet address. Also returns `correlated`: up to 8 other wallets that trade the same markets (each sharing at least 3 markets and $500 of volume with this one, compared over its 1,000 largest markets), most shared markets first, each with proxy_wallet, pseudonym, display_name, shared_markets, overlap_volume_usd, overlap_trades and last_seen; `[]` = none qualifies. Same data as GET /v1/polymarket/wallets/{address} plus /wallets/{address}/correlated.
name: polymarket_wallet
title: Polymarket Wallet
